dossier.form: Moss-and-bronze grazing giant with a suspended bell beneath its chest.
dossier.decision: Protect a chosen ally through a directional guarded sector.
dossier.positioning: Put a vulnerable ally behind the guarded shoulder; point the bell toward likely projectiles.
dossier.allies: Prism Organ benefits from time to cast; Grandmother Root prolongs the defensive line.
dossier.counterplay: Flank the guard or displace it away from its protected ally.
dossier.recognition: The chest bell tips forward and a short arc of bronze light marks the guarded sector.

ability.name: Sheltering Bell
ability.tooltip_en: Protect a chosen ally through a directional guarded sector. Flank the guard or displace it away from its protected ally.
ability.tooltip_id: Lindungi rekan di belakang sektor penjagaan. Serang dari samping atau pisahkan pelindung.

dossier.form: Long low predator with rocklike shoulder ridges and an elastic, expressive spine.
dossier.decision: Convert a clear approach into a committed burst of momentum.
dossier.positioning: Leave a short open approach; a crowded front row denies its charge.
dossier.allies: Reefglass clears a path; Bellback shelters the charge recovery.
dossier.counterplay: Screen the intended target and deny free landing cells.
dossier.recognition: A rising tail and successive footfall sparks count its momentum before the lunge.

ability.name: Stonebound Lunge
ability.tooltip_en: Convert a clear approach into a committed burst of momentum. Screen the intended target and deny free landing cells.
ability.tooltip_id: Bangun momentum dengan bergerak lalu menerjang. Tutup jalur dan petak pendaratan.

dossier.form: An orchard elder walking on broad roots, with a small sheltered garden in her torso.
dossier.decision: Establish a healing position that rewards holding ground.
dossier.positioning: Anchor beside several allies without exposing the whole group to artillery.
dossier.allies: Bellback protects the grove; Prism Organ turns the protected time into damage.
dossier.counterplay: Displace or interrupt her; concentrate burst before the grove pulses.
dossier.recognition: Roots settle, petals open and a restrained ground ring pulses with each heal.

ability.name: Stay and Blossom
ability.tooltip_en: Establish a healing position that rewards holding ground. Displace or interrupt her; concentrate burst before the grove pulses.
ability.tooltip_id: Diam untuk membuat taman penyembuhan. Dorong atau hentikan sebelum penyembuhan.

dossier.form: A low creeping flower whose folded petals conceal a thorn-lined jaw.
dossier.decision: Threaten a distant unit through a screened line strike.
dossier.positioning: Choose a lane where defenders do not lie between it and the backline.
dossier.allies: Reefglass removes screens; Cragstoat pressures the intercepted defender.
dossier.counterplay: Place a durable defender on its strike lane; alter the backline angle.
dossier.recognition: A thin root line traces the committed path before the jaw snaps along it.

ability.name: Thornline
ability.tooltip_en: Threaten a distant unit through a screened line strike. Place a durable defender on its strike lane; alter the backline angle.
ability.tooltip_id: Serang sasaran jauh melalui garis akar. Pelindung di jalur dapat mencegat.

dossier.form: Suspended ceramic organ pipes arranged around a stained-glass resonator.
dossier.decision: Punish enemies sharing crossing rows and columns.
dossier.positioning: Protect its long setup while scouting clustered opposing lines.
dossier.allies: Bellback absorbs approach pressure; Root sustains the protected casting position.
dossier.counterplay: Spread across rows and columns; interrupt the marked setup.
dossier.recognition: Two different musical notes and crossing ground lines announce the ordered beams.

ability.name: Crossing Hymn
ability.tooltip_en: Punish enemies sharing crossing rows and columns. Spread across rows and columns; interrupt the marked setup.
ability.tooltip_id: Tandai baris dan kolom lalu lepaskan sinar berurutan. Menyebar atau hentikan persiapan.

dossier.form: Glass-shelled cuttlefish drifting on ribbonlike fins, with visible currents inside.
dossier.decision: Push the first enemy in a directional tide and strike the occupied lane.
dossier.positioning: Orient toward a contested lane; leave a legal destination if the displacement matters.
dossier.allies: Snapvine exploits the opened lane; Root opponents lose their stationary setup.
dossier.counterplay: Stagger formations; block the push destination or attack from another side.
dossier.recognition: Its fins cup forward, a narrow current marks the lane, then the leading wave breaks.

ability.name: Leading Tide
ability.tooltip_en: Push the first enemy in a directional tide and strike the occupied lane. Stagger formations; block the push destination or attack from another side.
ability.tooltip_id: Hantam jalur depan dan dorong musuh pertama. Formasi berselang mengurangi dampaknya.

dossier.form: Eight-legged silk architect carrying a warm lantern abdomen.
dossier.decision: Set a finite trip line between two destructible anchors.
dossier.positioning: Place anchors where an approach is likely without exposing both to one attack.
dossier.allies: Prism Organ punishes trapped lanes; Bellback keeps anchor approaches protected.
dossier.counterplay: Use another route or destroy an anchor with ranged attacks.
dossier.recognition: Silk tightens visibly between two independently selectable lantern stakes.

planned_ability.name: Twin Lantern Line
planned_ability.behavior: Set a finite trip line between two destructible anchors.

dossier.form: A single coordinated colony of iridescent beetles sharing one banner-shaped shell.
dossier.decision: Flow around a defender and re-form behind it as one logical unit.
dossier.positioning: Seek a target with a free rear cell and avoid crowded clusters.
dossier.allies: Cragstoat creates simultaneous pressure from the front.
dossier.counterplay: Occupy rear cells; concentrated area damage pressures the single shared health pool.
dossier.recognition: The colony stretches around both sides, with one continuous selection ring and health bar.

planned_ability.name: Pour and Re-form
planned_ability.behavior: Flow around a defender and re-form behind it as one logical unit.

dossier.form: A squat glazed furnace-tortoise with hinged shield plates and steam valves.
dossier.decision: Capture a bounded number of frontal projectiles and vent steam afterward.
dossier.positioning: Face ranged lanes and put allies outside the vent recovery opening.
dossier.allies: Dawnkite and Prism Organ gain protected firing time.
dossier.counterplay: Melee attacks and side lanes bypass its collection arc.
dossier.recognition: Each captured projectile lights one kiln window; full windows precede the steam vent.

planned_ability.name: Furnace Count
planned_ability.behavior: Capture a bounded number of frontal projectiles and vent steam afterward.

dossier.form: A long branch-antlered dragon coiling around a suspended pearl.
dossier.decision: Create a delayed constricting ring with a safe center.
dossier.positioning: Aim to divide formations at the edge rather than cover every enemy.
dossier.allies: Reefglass can move an enemy into the ring edge; artillery punishes grouped safety.
dossier.counterplay: Spread, occupy the safe center, or interrupt the setup.
dossier.recognition: The pearl draws a clean circle before the dragon pulls the edge inward.

planned_ability.name: Pearl Constriction
planned_ability.behavior: Create a delayed constricting ring with a safe center.

dossier.form: A broad-winged dragon with layered dawn-colored membranes and a forked tail.
dossier.decision: Commit to a sweeping fan attack across a chosen sector.
dossier.positioning: Protect its back and aim a long diagonal across several threats.
dossier.allies: Bellback covers its vulnerable approach; Silkmother delays pursuers.
dossier.counterplay: Close flanks and rear pressure exploit its directional commitment.
dossier.recognition: Wing membranes open in order, illuminating the fan before the sweep.

planned_ability.name: Dawn Fan
planned_ability.behavior: Commit to a sweeping fan attack across a chosen sector.

dossier.form: A flower-mantis noble with petal armor and needlelike forearms.
dossier.decision: Challenge an isolated opponent with a short parry and riposte.
dossier.positioning: Find a side fight away from nearby enemy support.
dossier.allies: Reefglass separates the duel; Hushlantern repairs the risky commitment.
dossier.counterplay: Keep support nearby and apply ranged pressure outside the parry window.
dossier.recognition: Two petals close as a challenge marker; a single bright forearm flick marks the parry.

planned_ability.name: Petal Challenge
planned_ability.behavior: Challenge an isolated opponent with a short parry and riposte.

dossier.form: A practical itinerant tinkerer accompanying a little walking repair cart.
dossier.decision: Deploy a limited repair station for nearby allies.
dossier.positioning: Choose a station site that supports the front without feeding free demolition.
dossier.allies: Constructs and stationary teams benefit from the protected maintenance position.
dossier.counterplay: Destroy the station or move the fight outside its service radius.
dossier.recognition: The cart unfolds a small canopy; repair pulses travel visibly to recipients.

planned_ability.name: Wayside Workshop
planned_ability.behavior: Deploy a limited repair station for nearby allies.

dossier.form: An empty rain-cloak with a lantern where a head might be and trailing firefly echoes.
dossier.decision: Restore a capped part of recent lost health after a delay; never revive.
dossier.positioning: Stay close enough to a threatened ally while avoiding simultaneous area interruption.
dossier.allies: Duelists and frontline guardians benefit from surviving the delayed rescue.
dossier.counterplay: Burst through the delay or interrupt the rescue before release.
dossier.recognition: A faint health echo and a descending lantern bead show the committed rescue.

planned_ability.name: Remembered Health
planned_ability.behavior: Restore a capped part of recent lost health after a delay; never revive.

traits.name: Pack momentum
traits.behavior: Matching creatures gain a brief movement burst when an ally finishes a charge; no recursive triggers.

traits.name: Established ground
traits.behavior: Matching creatures grow a bounded protective layer while stationary; displacement clears growth.

traits.name: Colony routes
traits.behavior: Matching units gain a brief route bonus near friendly constructions, with one refresh per crossing.

traits.name: Stored energy
traits.behavior: Matching units store a bounded intercepted or absorbed hit count to shorten the next recovery.

traits.name: Ingenuity
traits.behavior: The first distinct allied station interaction each combat grants a bounded utility charge.

traits.name: Changing currents
traits.behavior: Successful displacements leave short directional currents supporting following allies.

traits.name: Unshared attention
traits.behavior: Matching units receive a short timing advantage in isolated engagements.

traits.name: Echo memory
traits.behavior: Matching rescuers retain a bounded recent-damage window; no revival or recursive rescue.

traits.name: Committed majesty
traits.behavior: Matching dragons extend telegraph commitment in exchange for a stronger spatial effect.

traits.name: Held line
traits.behavior: Guard matching allies in adjacent rear cells using visible directed links.

traits.name: Sustained pressure
traits.behavior: Matching units build capped pressure while remaining in close engagement; resets after disengagement.

traits.name: Single challenge
traits.behavior: Matching units obtain a bounded defensive window against an isolated opponent.

traits.name: Clear firing lanes
traits.behavior: Matching units benefit from protected straight firing lanes, losing the benefit when threatened nearby.

traits.name: Prepared magic
traits.behavior: Matching units build cast stability while allies screen nearby approaches.

traits.name: Care network
traits.behavior: Matching healers split a bounded fraction of effective rescue to another injured ally.

traits.name: Follow through
traits.behavior: Matching control effects expose a short displacement follow-up window, once per target.

traits.name: Service radius
traits.behavior: Matching constructions exchange a bounded service charge inside overlapping radii.

traits.name: Open approach
traits.behavior: Matching units gain one commitment benefit when reaching an unscreened target.
